name: DB Backup by Fairshare.tech
author: keshavgrover

sections.description:
WP DB Backup by Fairshare.tech automates the process of backing up your WordPress database. It creates a weekly backup using mysqldump and stores it in the wp_db_backup folder in your WordPress root directory. The backup file is then emailed to the site administrator as an attachment. No configuration is needed—just activate the plugin, and it works seamlessly.

Features:

  1. Weekly automated database backups.
  2. Stores backups in the wp_db_backup folder.
  3. Emails backups to the admin email address.
  4. Secure handling of database credentials.
  5. Cleans up scheduled tasks on deactivation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp_db_backup_by_fairshare folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure mysqldump is available on your server and the PHP exec() function is enabled.
  4. The plugin will automatically schedule weekly backups and email them to the admin email set in Settings > General.
sections.faq:
Where are the backup files stored? = Backup files are stored In wp-content/uploads/db_backup/ with timestamped filenames.

How do I receive the backups? = Backups are emailed weekly to the admin email address set in Settings > General. Ensure your server is configured to send emails (e.g., via an SMTP plugin if needed).

What if my server doesn’t have mysqldump or exec() enabled? = The plugin requires mysqldump and the PHP exec() function. If either is unavailable, the plugin will log an error in the WordPress debug log. Contact your hosting provider to enable these features or consider alternative backup solutions.

Can I change the backup schedule? = Currently, the plugin is set to run weekly. Future versions may include a settings page to customize the schedule.
